response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, long-tenured full-stack engineer with 15+ years of experience across web, mobile, and embedded systems, but his resume shows no evidence of experimentation platforms, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or growth engineering — the core domain of this role. His current and most recent titles are Staff/Senior, not Principal/IC6, and there's no indication of multi-team platform ownership or A/B testing/rollout-risk expertise required for this position.
strengths: Extensive 15+ year engineering career across many languages, stacks, and domains (web, mobile, embedded, distributed systems)
Demonstrated technical leadership: mentoring, workshops, talks, open-source project ownership (GISCollective)
Experience with high-throughput, low-latency systems at Dunnhumby (millions of requests/sec) showing some scale exposure
concerns: No mentioned experience with experimentation frameworks, A/B testing, feature flagging, or growth metrics systems — the core job focus
Current/most recent titles are Staff/Senior, not Principal, suggesting a seniority gap for an IC6 role
No evidence of cross-team platform ownership, stakeholder alignment, or translating business goals into measurable systems as required

key_factors.factor: Broad technical breadth and long engineering tenure
